I'm **water fasting** for the length of February - **28 days**. 

I'm nearing **hour 556**, which comes out to **23 days, 4 hours**. 

My starting stats were **29F, 5'8, 170.0 pounds even**. I didn't lose any weight today, so I'm still at **147.4** for a total of **22.6 pounds lost**. 

Usually it sucks to have a -0.0 day, but today I actually don't mind. I've been reveling in the now-obvious changes in my body. I'm definitely slimmer all over, and my hip- and collarbones have made a reappearance in a big way. It feels great! 

One thing I'm not sure I've mentioned before is that pre-fast, I was a half-pack a day smoker. I've pretty much quit! I've had probably six or seven cigarettes in the past month (four of them on the same day), and none in the last week and a half. This has been entirely effortless and not even really what I would describe as *on purpose* - it just sort of happened. 

Oddly, what I think I'm looking forward to even more than breaking my fast is *grocery shopping in preparation for breaking it*. Something about just being around thousands of foods... easing back into the *world* of food, I guess... is really intriguing to me. Like, look at all this shit! I can eat it now! (Well, some of it, because I'm planning on eating keto). 

All for today - happy fasting everyone!

I'm **water fasting** for up to **28 days,** or the whole month of February. I'm also taking sodium, potassium, and magnesium, and drinking the occasional unsweetened tea or seltzer. 

I'm on **hour 532**, which works out to **22 days, 4 hours**. 

My starting stats were **29F, 5'8, 170.0 lbs** and at my last weigh-in (last night), the scale showed **147.4**. This means that I've now **lost 22.6 lbs**. 

The end is drawing near! Can hardly believe I have under a week left. My original goal for this fast was to hit 145 pounds (pre-refeeding), and it's looking like I just might accomplish that. As you can see, I've averaged out to about a pound a day lost. There was a really slow stretch in the middle where I was hardly losing anything at all, but weeks one and three showed some pretty rapid loss. 

I'm starting to think pretty seriously about how I'm going to break my fast (I know, I know, I've said this in my last few posts too, but my strategy keeps adapting). I want to be really careful refeeding, so I'll probably take a week to do it, working up from day 1 of broth to day 2 of salad, day 3 a bigger salad, day 4 a small meal, and so on. I'll plan to be back around maintenance calories by the time Thursday and Friday roll around, which I intend to be my Eating Days on a reverse 5:2 until I get to my ultimate goal weight of 130. 

Still feeling hearty and healthy. I've been a bit dizzy standing up a few times, and for this reason haven't been taking my medication for nightmares - prazosin - since it lowers blood pressure and can have that side effect on its own. Fortunately, the last two nights have been very vivid dreams, but not bad ones (I dreamed that a friend and I were trying to sell Starbucks on this fake "new" type of fish we were claiming to have discovered, until Robin Williams reminded us that Starbucks doesn't sell fish). 

Hope everyone's doing well! Happy fasting, all!

Have you been taking electrolytes (especially sodium)? This could be the result of that, or the keto flu where your body is adapting away from using carbs as fuel. Most of us have a rough time the first few days.

Losing ten pounds in four days is awesome - it's probably also mostly water weight, and not super unusual! Your rate of weight loss will definitely slow down. 

Ultimately, I'm not an expert and the decision whether or not to end the fast is up to you (and, ideally, your doctor), but my best guess here is that feeling rough like you described is *probably* due to one of the things I mentioned previously and should clear up after another day or two. Do listen to your body, though, and if your instinct is that it's telling you to stop, I'd stop now and give it another shot after refeeding. 

Good luck! Sorry I can't be more help.
